column1: # core/data/talk/acts.tsv - the discourse acts' adjacency table (owner: TK, T5a;
# docs/TALK.md "The generator", design 3.1 and quality check Q2).
#   ACT      a talk.h TA_* act without the prefix; every act has a row
#   CLASS    open ask tell warm cool third flow romance gesture safety (talk.h TAC_*:
#            the openers are chosen by the class of the act they answer)
#   REPLIES  the acts a resident's line may perform in answer (comma separated).
#            The first is the default reply act of a core.<act> rule with no
#            `act:`. talkc refuses a core.<ACT> rule whose reply act is not here,
#            and a react.<R> rule is only used after a line R may answer.
# A reaction (one resident to another) answers the previous LINE's act, so
# the reply acts have rows too.
